description: Utility functions for data formatting, key updating, and clipboard operations in a dashboard UI.

methods.name: updateExistingKeys
methods.description: Updates existing keys in a target object with values from a source object, returning a cloned object.

methods.name: formatNumberWithCommas
methods.description: Formats a number with commas, optional abbreviation, and decimal precision.

methods.name: getSpendString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing a monetary value, with thresholds for small values.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using modern API with fallback, and shows success or error notifications.
